_note: Declarative settings for the ElevenLabs agent «scg-anna». Prompt text, first messages, analysis and tools come from elevenlabs/prompt/*, elevenlabs/analysis/* and src/contract (via scripts/gen-tools.ts). build-agent.ts is idempotent (create or PATCH by name). No secrets in this file.
name: scg-anna

agent._language_note: Default ru (the caller hears the RU greeting). A preset is pushed for EVERY listed language, the default included: the live agent still holds a stale ru preset (old greeting) that must be overwritten. Each preset: language, first_message (presets.json), max-duration and soft-timeout messages; no prompt or voice override.
agent._greeting_note: Greeting interruptible (decision 2026-10-06): if the caller talks over the greeting, Anna's first reply starts «Это Анна, ИИ-ассистент.» (system_prompt.md), so the AI disclosure still comes before any question.

max_duration_message.ru: Время разговора закончилось. Спасибо за звонок, всего доброго.
max_duration_message.lv: Sarunas laiks ir beidzies. Paldies par zvanu, visu labu.

agent._punctuation_note: No «!» in any first, max-duration or soft-timeout message (decision 2026-10-06: «!» makes the voice jump); build-agent.ts refuses one.

tts._model_note: The TTS model is this ONE value (decision 2026-10-06 «Voice audition result»: Anna ET on eleven_v4_turbo, about 300 credits/min in total; v4 turbo lists lv, so the LV preset stays). Fallback: Elena Gromova (see _voice) on eleven_v4_turbo; change voice_id, stability, speed and similarity_boost together.
tts._voice: Anna ET (Kodukliima): a Voice Design voice already in the account (no add needed), the same voice as the agent «Anna - Kodukliima demo» (agent_1701m3a6001cebc8r1n6saqxmqn6); picked by ear in the WPV6 audition (2026-10-06) at stability 0.5, similarity_boost 0.75, speed 1.0. ONE voice for RU and LV (no per-language voice override). Fallback: Elena Gromova 0ArNnoIAWKlT4WweaVMY (Voice Library, public_owner_id 18bb7017de812f7caa40ebbe9059def999a627a113e50e82fb819f0ea77a497d, added to the account 2026-10-05) on eleven_v4_turbo, speed 1.1, stability 0.4, similarity_boost 0.75.

turn._turn_eagerness_note: normal for the video (decision 2026-10-06 «Turn-taking and ASR for the video»); eager cut callers off.
turn._turn_timeout_note: About five seconds of caller silence → Anna says once «Алло, вы меня слышите?», then skip_turn (system_prompt.md §3; decision 2026-10-06).
turn._interruption_note: Backchannels that must not interrupt Anna: the Kodukliima list (read live 2026-10-06) plus «ага» and «да-да» (decision 2026-10-06 «Turn-taking and ASR for the video»), languages ru/lv/en, without the platform's default list.

asr._note: Video set (decision 2026-10-06 «Turn-taking and ASR for the video»): only the names the two video calls need. The full list (_keywords_pilot: Latvian street/district names, Gate S carry-forward #2) returns for the pilot and the LV polish.

conversation._note: 600 s while the video is rehearsed and recorded (decision 2026-10-06 «Call cap 600 s»); back to 300 afterwards.

privacy._note: Audio is not stored; transcripts are kept 90 days (latency metrics still work).

_tools_note: Allowlist of contract tools that gen-tools / build-agent / check-agent handle. M1 = these 7. WP13 adds create_ticket and log_request together with the M2 prompt; until then el:build must not attach them to the live agent.
_system_tools_note: skip_turn (2026-10-06): Anna stays silent on noise, background talk or an empty message, and after her one «Алло, вы меня слышите?» when the silence continues. Descriptions come from elevenlabs/prompt/tool_descriptions.json.
